{{Top|leg}}
'''Farpoint''' was the largest population center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fhost]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was built on the ruins of a [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]] that crashed on Fhost prior to the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole cantina]] was located in the bridge of the ship, and [[Farpoint Tower]] was located in the city as well.
